name: Sandrone

abilities.name: Formule Phenomenale: Self-Evident Proposition
abilities.caveat: A Charged Attack summons Fagio, which keeps firing condensed beams in game — the timeline gives it no summon row and no ticks.

sections.title: Normal Attack
sections.description: Generates threads that control her weapon using formulae, performing up to 3 consecutive strikes.

sections.title: Charged Attack
sections.description:
Summons the Facilitatrice Automatisee Generaliste Interactive et Omnitache, or "Fagio," and switches it to **Decoding** mode: Unleashes a sweeping fire attack on enemies in front, as well as periodically fires condensed beams, dealing AoE Cryo DMG.
Radiance: Stellar-Conduct: The condensed beams will instead deal AoE Cryo DMG that is considered Stellar-Conduct DMG.
While in Decoding mode, Fagio's **Decoding Power** will continuously increase. Firing condensed beams will also further increase its Decoding Power.
When Fagio's Decoding Power reaches the maximum of 100 points, it switches to Power Overdrive mode, in which it fires at opponents with longer intervals, dealing Cryo DMG. It will be unable to switch to Decoding mode at this time.
When not in Decoding mode, Fagio's Decoding Power gradually decreases. When Sandrone is off-field, she will focus on maintaining Fagio, causing its Decoding Power to decrease at 300% the original rate.
Fagio exits Power Overdrive mode when its Decoding Power has decreased to under 50.

sections.title: Plunging Attack
sections.description: Plunges from midair to strike the ground below, dealing DMG to opponents along their path and causing AoE DMG on landing.

abilities.name: Formule Phenomenale: Differential Analysis
abilities.description:
With her impeccable, ladylike poise, Sandrone boards the Tea Party Tactical Assault Hovermech and hovers forward for 6s. During this time, Sandrone can control the travel direction of the craft. Pressing Sprint consumes 10 Stamina and launches her into an elegant high-speed hover mode, in which she will move even faster at the cost of 15 Stamina per second.

When Sandrone starts hovering, if there are opponents nearby, she will also summon a Prismatic Resonance Cannon and fire 2 Prism Shots at any opponents who have yet to cool down, dealing Cryo DMG.
**Radiance: Stellar Glimmer**: The second Prism Shot will instead deal Cryo DMG that is considered the corresponding Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG.

When on the Tea Party Tactical Assault Hovermech, Sandrone will also elegantly and quietly repair Fagio, causing **Decoding Power** to swiftly decrease.
_curatorNotes: activeDuration 6 (2026-09-15, essential-characters T0): the kit text states the hovermech ride lasts 6s ('boards the Tea Party Tactical Assault Hovermech and hovers forward for 6s'), and the E had drawn as a bare instant. `activeDuration`, not `behavior: stance` — a stance would open `inStance` and claim a mode her normals and conditions read, which no source describes; the window is the only thing stated. With a 4s cooldown the bars overlap, which is the kit. No gcsim source (checked 2026-09-15), so no frames, no application[] and no Prismatic Resonance Cannon cadence: the two Prism Shots are a count with no timing.

abilities.name: Formule Phenomenale: Q.E.D.
abilities.description:
In line with established ladylike behavior, Sandrone summons a large number of Prismatic Resonance Cannons for a frontal bombardment before firing on her foes with a Convective Inhibition Ray, dealing AoE Cryo DMG.
**Radiance: Stellar Glimmer**: The Convective Inhibition Ray instead deals AoE Cryo DMG that is considered the corresponding Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG.

passives.name: Eternal Speculation Engine
_curatorNotes: A1 (self-damage amplification, not modeled). Two intertwined mechanics both ride on untracked state: (a) the enhanced second Prism Shot (400% of its DMG) is gated on Fagio's Decoding Power > 50 and being in the Radiance: Stellar-Conduct state — Decoding Power is a continuous resource the planner does not simulate; (b) Refined Tactics stacks accrue per 10 Decoding Power lost (max 10, 60s) and, on a Radiance-state burst, boost the Convective Inhibition Ray to 100% + stacks×10% of its DMG. No primitive tracks Decoding-Power loss, and the amp lands on Sandrone's own on-field burst hit (FrameMap territory, and Sandrone is frameless). Left unauthored.

↻ CAVEAT REMOVED 2026-08-19 (ruthless pass, Nate-approved): no pixel — Both halves are pure damage MAGNITUDE (a shot dealing 400% of its DMG; a ray dealing 100%+stacks×10%). The tool renders no damage numbers anywhere by constitution, so there is no bar, marker or value that reads wrong — nothing on screen changes whether these exist or not. Category: invisible-omission.
passives.description:
**Radiance: Stellar Glimmer**: When using the Elemental Skill **Formule Phenomenale: Differential Analysis**, if Fagio's **Decoding Power** is greater than 50, the second Prism Shot fired by Fagio at nearby opponents will deal 400% of its original DMG as Fagio's Decoding Power is decreased.
Additionally, for every 10 points of Decoding Power Fagio loses, it gains 1 stack of Refined Tactics for 60s (max 10 stacks). When Sandrone uses the Elemental Burst **Formule Phenomenale: Q.E.D.** while in the Radiance: Stellar Glimmer state, all stacks of Refined Tactics are cleared, causing the Convective Inhibition Ray to deal 100% + (number of stacks cleared) × 10% of its original DMG.

notModeled.reason: The Rotation Planner doesn't draw damage amounts, and this only raises how hard Fagio's second Prism Shot and the Convective Inhibition Ray hit.

passives.name: Stellar Jubilee: Light of Rationalisme
_curatorNotes: THE Stellar-Conduct enabler: `enablesReactions: ['stellarConduct']` at the character root is what converts every party Superconduct to Stellar-Conduct and satisfies every teammate's `teamEnablesReaction` gate. Sandrone is the only enabler in the current patch (Fandom 'Light of Rationalisme', Luna VIII). Authored 2026-07-29 from the Fandom talent page — this passive is a genshin-db extraPassive and was previously absent from this JSON.

Base Stellar-Conduct DMG buff: 0.7% per 100 ATK, max 14%, party-wide (Fandom: 'party members' Base Stellar-Conduct DMG will be increased based on Sandrone's ATK'). Bucket-3 of the Stellar formula → `stellarConductDmgBonus`, scaling ratio 0.7 (per the per-100-ATK ratio convention used by her A4), cap 14.

Polestar Field team effects taken from the Fandom Stellar-Conduct page (Provided Buffs table): characters inside the field get +20% Cryo and Electro DMG Bonus at 0 recorded hits, and all enemies in the field take -40% Physical RES flat at every hit count. The variable half (28% + 1% per recorded Cryo/Electro hit, up to 40% at 12 hits) rides the field's hit-recording ledger and is not modeled. Trigger is `onReaction stellarConduct, source: team` — any party member's Stellar-Conduct creates the field; no `teamEnablesReaction` condition is needed because the holder IS the enabler.

Duration 4s / refresh comes straight from the wiki wording ('Every 4s, the count is reset, and buffs lasting 4s are granted'). The FIELD's own lifetime is only 'a short period of time' in the talent text — never invented; the 4s grant cycle is the honest window and the field is not drawn as a summon (Nate's call 2026-07-29).

NOT authored: the Base Reaction Coefficient (1 → 1.45 at one recorded hit, +0.05 per further hit, cap 2 at 12 hits). Unmodelable per the library doc. ⚠️ DISCREPANCY: docs/library/game/stellar-reactions.md assumes '1.4 + 0.05n' (1.45 at n=1); the Fandom Provided Buffs table reads '1 + 40% + 5% per hit' and its table lists 1.45 at 1 hit — so the doc's NEEDS-CONFIRM is resolved in favor of the table, but its prose ('starts at 1.4') should be corrected to 1.45.

Also unmodelable: 'when Sandrone is within a Polestar Field, she enters the Radiance: Stellar-Conduct state' — the Radiance state gates her own DMG conversions (A1, C2, C6) and there is no field-presence primitive.

↻ 7.0 RE-AUTHOR 2026-08-31 (genshin-db 5.2.13). HoYo generalised every "Stellar-Conduct" reference in this kit to "Stellar Glimmer" — the umbrella covering Stellar-Conduct AND Stellar Swirl — and split the numbers where the two differ. Descriptions re-synced from genshin-db; stats re-keyed to the umbrella family. The A4 now converts Superconduct OR Cryo Swirl (→ Stellar-Conduct or Stellar Swirl) and raises "the Base DMG of said reaction" — either one — so the 0.7%/100 ATK (cap 14) buff moved from `stellarConductDmgBonus` to the family-wide `stellarGlimmerDmgBonus`. She is declared an enabler of BOTH.

↻ CAVEAT REMOVED 2026-08-31: it said the Polestar Field buffs "are not simulated". ⚓ Nate ruled a field is treated like any other dropped field — assume the play is inside it — so there is no on-screen divergence left to repair. Under name-the-pixel the caveat does not exist.

⚓⚓ THE THREE POLESTAR FIELD EFFECTS WERE REMOVED HERE 2026-09-01 AND ARE NOT A GAP. They were a MIRROR: +20% Cryo DMG, +20% Electro DMG and −40% enemy Physical RES are properties of the Polestar Field, which ANY party member's Stellar-Conduct creates — not of this character. Each enabler carried a private copy only because the corpus had no home for reaction-level data, and the cost was real twice over: a party fielding two enablers drew two identical bars, and the copy printed the field's ZERO-HIT baseline (+20%) as though it were the value, when the ledger takes it to 29% at one recorded Cryo/Electro hit and 40% at twelve. The field is now produced by the parse itself (`src/lib/sim/fields.ts`), draws its own Prism span in the gadget strip, and recomputes the bonus per 4s grant cycle. ⛔ Do not re-author these on a new enabler — an enabler needs `enablesReactions` and nothing else for the field to appear.
passives.description:
Sandrone will enter the Radiance: Stellar-Conduct state when she is inside a **Polestar Field**, or the Radiance: Stellar Swirl state for 8s after a nearby party member triggers a Stellar Swirl reaction.
When a party member triggers a Superconduct or Cryo Swirl reaction, it becomes a Stellar-Conduct or Stellar Swirl reaction instead, and the Base DMG of the aforementioned reaction is also increased by 0.7% for every 100 points of Sandrone's ATK. A maximum increase of 14% can be obtained in this way.

constellations.description:
When Fagio fires a condensed beam for the third time while in **Decoding** mode, the beam becomes a more powerful Condensed Cluster Beam that fires continuously. This beam will deal up to 4 additional instances of AoE Cryo DMG at 100% of Sandrone's ATK on top of any subsequent original beam fired.
Radiance: Stellar Glimmer: The Condensed Cluster Beam attack deals 4 additional instances of AoE Cryo DMG. The DMG dealt with this attack, which is considered the corresponding Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG, is equal to:
Radiance: Stellar-Conduct: 80% of Sandrone's ATK.
Radiance: Stellar Swirl: 120% of Sandrone's ATK.
Additionally, all Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG dealt by Sandrone is **elevated** by 20%.

_curatorNotes: Effects pass 2026-07-14 (Stages 1-3 only; no gcsim source exists for Sandrone — no frames, stays FRAMELESS_EXEMPT). CD/energy verified against docs/curation/talents/sandrone.json: E 4s, Q 15s / 60 energy — all PASS.

STELLAR PASS 2026-07-29 (Fandom-only evidence — gcsim has no Stellar implementation; pages fetched via the MediaWiki API: Light of Rationalisme, Stellar-Conduct, all six constellations, all three talents). Sandrone is an on-field Cryo claymore CARRY who is also THE Stellar-Conduct enabler. Landed this round: root `enablesReactions: ['stellarConduct']`; a new 'Light of Rationalisme' passive node (previously a genshin-db extraPassive documented only in these notes) carrying the team Base Stellar-Conduct DMG buff plus the Polestar Field's modelable baselines; C6's +20% elevate on her Stellar-Conduct DMG.

Polestar Field team benefits are now AUTHORED on the Light of Rationalisme passive from the Fandom Stellar-Conduct page's Provided Buffs table (which the pre-release 2026-07-14 pass could not reach): +20% Cryo and Electro DMG Bonus to characters in the field, -40% Physical RES on enemies in the field (stored negative). The hit-recording half — the Base Reaction Coefficient and the 28%+1%/hit ramp to 40% — stays unmodelable per Nate's 2026-07-29 call. See that passive's notes for the coefficient discrepancy against docs/library/game/stellar-reactions.md.

Values re-verified against the live Fandom pages 2026-07-29: E CD 4s, Q 15s / 60 energy, A4 EM conversion (8 EM per 100 ATK, max 160), C1 +30%, C2 40%/+20% max 3, C4 125% ATK / 4s, C6 100%/80% ATK and +20% elevation — all unchanged from the pre-release authoring. No corrections were needed. Talent scaling in docs/curation/talents/sandrone.json also matches the wiki's Attribute Scaling tables (spot-checked skill and burst).

Fagio (summoned by Charged Attack) 'periodically fires condensed beams' but no official firing interval is stated (a secondary guide guessed ~1/s; unverified), so no summon/summonTick is authored — never fake cadence. Fagio is an on-field-driven carry mechanism (Decoding Power decays 300% faster while Sandrone is off-field), not an autonomous off-field summon, so it grants no off-field-DMG capability.

Still unauthored after the Stellar pass: C1's +30% Stellar-Conduct DMG (Reaction Bonus bucket — no primitive), C2/C4/C6 damage magnitudes, A1's Decoding-Power amplifiers, and the Radiance: Stellar-Conduct state itself (no field-presence primitive). Each carries a caveat on its own node. No heal, shield, cleanse, or grouping in the kit (external healers/shielders required per every source).
